## Problem

What communication problem does this address?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the user-visible behavior.

## Speaker-control check

- [ ] Agent inference remains distinguishable from speaker-endorsed content.
- [ ] The speaker can correct or reject the agent.
- [ ] Public sending still requires explicit human approval.
- [ ] The feature does not silently invent reasons, facts, or commitments for the speaker.
